summary:
complete. M1 heavy validation done; 4 benchmark docs written (uncommitted) on `agent/spikes-m1`.

**Setup (uv, no brew):** `uv` 0.13.5 via direct script, `uv python install 3.12` → 3.12.15. Drove the repo's own `src/cyv/setup.py` plan with `CYV_HOME=/tmp/cyv-heavy`: venv → `project[daemon]` → Applio @ `c817f1f8` (= pin) → `requirements-engine.txt` → spaCy model → all `models.toml` weights, every sha256 verified (985 MB). Installed set matches B0 except spacy 3.8.16 (was 3.8.14, unpinned — works). Espeak bundled dylib loads, no fallback needed. `~/.cyv` untouched.

**Measured (Apple M1 8 GB, macOS 27.2, torch 2.11.0, `/usr/bin/time -l`):**

| Stage (per 10 s audio) | Result |
|---|---|
| Peak RSS, HuBERT+RMVPE+Kokoro+AudioSeal warm (no voice) | **1.35 GB** max RSS |
| Kokoro synth 10.8 s line, MPS | cold 6.8–16 s (kernel compile), **warm 1.38–1.43 s** |
| ContentVec embed | MPS **0.20 s** vs CPU 0.34 s |
| RMVPE f0 | MPS warm **0.33–0.45 s** (cold 2.65 s) vs CPU 0.74–0.78 s |
| AudioSeal embed / detect | CPU **0.27 / 0.14 s**; MPS 0.27 / 0.64 s (+ dynamo recompile warnings) |
| SDPA on MPS | **passes**; ContentVec uses `sdpa` impl — macOS 26 bug gone on 27.2 |
| Preset encodes | master 0.12 s, telegram 0.16 s, mp3 0.10 s |
| E2E smoke (synth→embed→3 presets) | OK; watermark reads back after Opus 32k, prob 1.0, exact message |

**Policy set:** everything MPS except AudioSeal on CPU; keep `_MPS_MARKERS` retry as safety net. **Bad news reported:** provisional warm ≤1.5 s target already missed by TTS+f0+embed alone (~2.0 s before the voice net runs) — in `B3-latency.md`.

**`uv lock` groundwork:** plain `uv lock` succeeds (128 pkgs) but resolves torch 2.14.1 vs setup's real 2.11.0 — drifts, so not committable. Blockers documented in `setup-m1.md`: Applio has no build metadata (can't be a git dep), `requirements-engine.txt`/`daemon-constraints.txt`/spacy-URL all live outside project metadata. Recommended status quo for v1, no restructure done.

**Blocked (needs a Colab-trained pack — B1 stays Colab-only, no training attempted):** voice-conditioned convert, full `say`/`convert` E2E, with-voice B2 close-out (~1.5–1.8 GB extrapolated from Linux 2.9 GB figure — marked as estimate). Unblocks: train pack → `cyv voices import` → rerun bench tails under `time -l`. Notebook pin consistency confirmed by existing tests (36 passed, 4 skipped).

**Files (all new, uncommitted on `agent/spikes-m1`, base `3e5c009` intact, no commits/pushes):** `docs/benchmarks/B2-memory.md`, `B3-latency.md`, `audioseal-mps.md`, `setup-m1.md`. Scratch left behind: `/tmp/cyv-heavy` (2.4 GB: venv, Applio checkout, models, bench scripts + `spike_results.json`, e2e outputs), `/tmp/uvlock-probe` (lock experiment), `/tmp/cyv-b0-m1` (pre-existing B0 venv, reused read-only as driver).
